Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
EMPLOYEES' OLD-AGE
BENEFITS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th March, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
20-3-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Employees' Old-Age
Benefits (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at once
and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of January, 2000.

Amendment of the Schedule  Act No XIV of 1976

ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
EMPLOYEES' OLD-AGE
BENEFITS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE IX OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th March, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
20-3-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
2. Amendment of the Schedule,
Act No. XIV of 1976.--In the Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 1976, in the
Schedule,--
(a) in paragraph (2),--
(i) in the proviso for the words
"four hundred and twenty-five", the words "six hundred and
thirty" shall be substituted; and
(ii) for the word, comma and
figure "July, 1991 ", the word, comma and figure "January,
2000" shall be substituted; and
(b) Paragraph (3) shall be omitted.
